import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000009L;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, f, c;
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static int src, snk;
    static List<List<Integer>> gph;
    static List<Edge> edg;

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap) {
        gph.get(u).add(edg.size());
        edg.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
        gph.get(v).add(edg.size());
        edg.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static int[] p = new int[1001];
    static int[] d = new int[1001];

    static boolean levelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : gph.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edg.get(id);
                if (d[e.v] == -1 && e.f < e.c) {
                    d[e.v] = d[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.v);
                    if (e.v == snk) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long augment(int u, long f) {
        if (u == snk || f == 0) return f;
        for (int i = p[u]; i < gph.get(u).size(); i++) {
            p[u] = i;
            int id = gph.get(u).get(i);
            Edge e = edg.get(id);
            if (d[e.v] != d[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = augment(e.v, Math.min(f, (long)e.c - e.f));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.f += pushed;
                edg.get(id ^ 1).f -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long flow() {
        long total = 0;
        while (levelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(p, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = augment(src, INF)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static String[] sci = new String[101];
    static String[] rec = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] connected = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] mark = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] failAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;

    static boolean inGrid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int node(int r, int c) {
        return 1 + m * r + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        ++T;
        m = n;
        snk = m * m * 2 + 1;
        src = 0;
        gph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; i++) {
            gph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        edg = new ArrayList<>();
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            rec[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                failAt[i][j] = (int)INF;
                if (rec[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    failAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + di, ny = y + dj;
                        if (inGrid(nx, ny) && failAt[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            failAt[nx][ny] = failAt[x][y] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                char c = sci[x].charAt(y);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    link(src, node(x, y), c - '0');
                }
                c = rec[x].charAt(y);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    link(n * n + node(x, y), snk, c - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            rec[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || rec[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                            Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> bq = new LinkedList<>();
                        bq.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        mark[x][y] = 1;
                        while (!bq.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cell = bq.poll();
                            int cx = cell[0], cy = cell[1], t = cell[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                mark[cx][cy] = 1;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (t >= failAt[cx][cy] || t >= T) continue;
                            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + di, ny = cy + dj;
                                        if (inGrid(nx, ny) && mark[nx][ny] == 0 &&
                                            sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                            t + 1 <= failAt[nx][ny]) {
                                            mark[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            bq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, t + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (mark[X][Y] == 1) {
                            link(node(x, y), n * n + node(X, Y), (int)INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow());
    }
}
